name: AEGIS-Attention V1: Adaptive Enhanced Global-Local Integrated Sparse Attent
description: AEGIS-Attention V1: Adaptive Enhanced Global-Local Integrated Sparse Attention Baseline.  Combines SVD-factorized projection matrices with energy-based rank selection and LoRA adapters, split-head local sliding-window attention with smooth activations, and global linear kernel attention with adaptive gating. Hardened for multi-architecture deployment across DistilBERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2, and Qwen3.5.
